description: To inculcate software design abilities. Impart knowledge-based awareness of user requirements. To enable the students to conduct feasibility analysis. Knowledge of software quality testing for its sustainability, reliability and durability.

syllabus.title: Introduction
syllabus.body: Software Crisis, Software Characteristics, and Software Processes; Software life cycle models – Build & Fix, waterfall prototype evolutionary, spiral model.

syllabus.title: Problem Analysis
syllabus.body: DFD, Data dictionaries, ER diagrams, object diagrams; approaches to problems analysis; SRS; specifying behavioral & non-behavioral requirements, software configuration management.

syllabus.title: Software Design and Implementation
syllabus.body: Modularity, strategy of design, function-oriented design, object-oriented design, User interface design, UML modelling, Software implementation.

syllabus.title: Software Quality
syllabus.body: Size metrics, data structure metrics, information flow metrics, entropy-based measures, metric analysis, Software Quality Frameworks, ISO 9001 Model, SEI-CMM Model.

syllabus.title: Software Validation and Reliability
syllabus.body: Software Testing, verification and validation, errors, failures, faults, fault tolerance, Software Maintenance, reliability models – macro, basic, logarithmic Poisson, calendar time component, micro models.

outcomes: Apply the concepts to choose appropriate software process models as per user requirements.
Analyze requirement techniques, including Data flow diagram, Entity relationship diagram, and Object diagram.
Understand the various Software Design strategies for software implementation and emphasize different software metrics used for analyzing the software.
Design and test the various software reliability measures to assess software quality in case of multiple faults and failures.
textbooks: Pressman, R.S. and Maxim, B.R., Software Engineering: A Practitioner's Approach, 9th ed., McGraw Hill, 2020.
Sommerville, Ian, Software Engineering, 10th ed., Pearson Education 2017.
K.K.Aggarwal, Yogesh Singh: Software Engineering, New Age International Ltd, 2001.
Pankaj Jalote, An Integrated Approach to Software Engineering 3rd Ed., 2005 Narosa Publishing.
referenceBooks: Singh, Y., Software Testing, Cambridge University Press, 2013.
